statement: A regularized model of interpretable intraday state (noise-normalized move, gap, trend efficiency, vol ratio, relative strength, time) predicts the sign of the rest-of-session return better than simple momentum.
mechanism: Combines momentum/reversal/regime information; tests whether conditioning adds value over H3.
falsification: Walk-forward net Sharpe below the pure-momentum baseline (sign of noise-normalized move) or < 0.5.
params_tested: logistic C {0.1}, GBM depth 2/200 trees; threshold {0.03,0.06}; expanding yearly walk-forward with whole-day embargo
baseline: sign(move from open / noise sigma) at the same decision points
